name: hira_lump
desc: The horse man has completely melted down: replace the whole character with a shapeless, heaving mass of the same glossy brown paint with cream swirls, rising from a wide puddle on the floor at the same spot: a tall mound about 60 percent of his height that widens toward the top to about the width of his chest and shoulders and narrows at the bottom into the puddle, with many thick heavy drips running down. No head, no face, no arms, no shoulders, no legs, no body shapes at all, just thick sticky goo welling up, bubbles swelling and popping, sticky strands. Same colors, outline and pixel art style.
